items.q: What is recency bias in investing?
items.a: Assuming what did well **recently will keep doing well** indefinitely.

items.q: How concentrated is the S&P 500 now?
items.a: The top 10 companies are about **37% of the index**, up from 24% in 2017.

items.q: What does Cisco teach about AI stocks?
items.a: You can be **right about the technology and still lose** if profits don't justify prices.
Add up all accounts and see **how much rides on the same thing**.

items.q: When should you decide your downturn plan?
items.a: **Now, while markets are calm**, not after they fall.

items.q: How can you rebalance without selling?
items.a: **Redirect new money** into other investments until weights even out.
